simulation.subject: Action Required: Annual SOX Policy Attestation Update for Finance
simulation.body:
Dear Jonathan,

As part of our ongoing commitment to regulatory standards and Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance, the annual policy re-attestation window for the Finance directorate has officially opened. 

Given recent updates to our internal control frameworks regarding cross-border transaction logging, all senior finance personnel are required to review and sign the revised attestation document within the standard 48-hour compliance verification cycle.

Please review the updated guidelines and complete your attestation via the secure governance portal:

[SIMULATED LINK: Aurelius Compliance Portal - SOX Attestation]

Failure to complete this re-attestation prior to the audit lock window may result in a temporary suspension of system provisioning privileges for financial reporting modules.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.

Regards,

Compliance & Regulatory Oversight Directorate
Aurelius Global Audit Corp
